title: Arming the cart and firing it
target: How to arm the cart in R.E.P.O. and use what you fitted, given that the cannon and the laser are separate weapons with different behaviour.
version: R.E.P.O. v0.4.0, as installed for this build (see the sources page for the exact version string)
prerequisites: Money or a find for a weapon
A route where a weapon is worth carrying

steps.do: Decide which weapon the cart gets before buying one, since they are separate items.
steps.because: the laser is its own item, apart from the cannon (ItemCartLaser)

steps.do: Give the weapon time to open before expecting it to fire.
steps.because: the laser has hatches with their own opening curves (animationCurveHatchType1)

steps.do: Treat the warning light as a warning rather than as decoration.
steps.because: it has a warning light with a curve of its own (animationCurveWarningLight)

steps.do: Fire deliberately rather than holding on, if it is a single-shot weapon.
steps.because: the laser records whether it fires one shot at a time (semiLaser)

steps.do: Remember the cart has to come with you for the weapon to matter.
steps.because: both weapons are items made for the cart (ItemCartCannon)

commonMistakes: Buying a cart weapon and leaving the cart behind.
Firing while the hatches are still opening.
Using a single-shot weapon as though it were automatic.
sources: This installation of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
